player._note: P2-S5 (#443): the Player animated sprite SET. Its committed form is the derived SpriteFrames recorded under manifest id 'player' (gADR-0016, Model S); the per-state sheets player_<state>.png are its backing. Landed as a procedural PLACEHOLDER — wave-close acquisition replaces the art per animation state (idle/run/jump/fire/hurt/consume/level_up/death) through this recipe.
